name: VR Headset XR Bridge Driver
author: SOFTDEV0 LLC / SarahMemory Community
description: Governed XR runtime/headset bridge for SarahMemory AiOS. Detects XR-capable runtimes and devices, negotiates resolution/runtime launch, exports scene/avatar requests, and degrades cleanly when optional VR stacks are absent.

notes.design_boundary: This package is a hardware/runtime bridge, not a full scene-generation or render engine.
notes.primary_contract: Use OpenXR-capable runtimes when present; export scene/avatar requests into the wider SarahMemory creative/runtime pipeline.
